title: Custo target discovery
description: Repository discovery scope and policy engine paths for Sync Managed Files.

scope.description: all-access discovers all repositories visible to the current app installation token; organizations restricts discovery to listed organizations.

organizations.description: GitHub organization logins to scan when scope is organizations.

policy.description: Policy engine folder mapping and enterprise selection.

rootPath.description: Relative or absolute root path that contains Capabilities/ and Policies/.
